# IKEA Global

> Global IKEA hub for company information, stories, careers, newsroom updates, and business topics behind the IKEA brand.

IKEA Global complements country storefronts with corporate, editorial, and brand-level information about IKEA’s business, values, people, and impact. It is the best entry point for understanding IKEA beyond local shopping sites.

## Global Home
- [IKEA Global](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/): Global homepage for IKEA brand information, stories, jobs, newsroom, and business topics.
- [Stories](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/stories/): Editorial hub with articles on home life, design, sustainability, and IKEA initiatives.
- [Jobs](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/jobs/): Careers hub covering work at IKEA, culture, values, and job opportunities.
- [Newsroom](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/newsroom/): Official press and media hub for IKEA news, announcements, and statements.
- [Our business](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/our-business/): Overview of how IKEA operates, creates value, and develops its business.

## Stories
- [Stories](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/stories/): Main stories index featuring editorial content from across IKEA Global.
- [Life at home](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/stories/life-at-home/): Articles and insights about everyday living, homes, and changing needs.
- [Design and innovation](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/stories/design-and-innovation/): Stories about product development, design thinking, and innovation at IKEA.
- [Sustainability](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/stories/sustainability/): Editorial coverage of climate, circularity, materials, and responsible business efforts.
- [People and culture](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/stories/people-and-culture/): Features on coworkers, workplace culture, and inclusion across IKEA.
- [Retail and business](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/stories/retail-and-business/): Stories about retail development, customers, and IKEA business evolution.

## Jobs and Careers
- [Jobs](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/jobs/): Careers landing page with IKEA employer information and recruitment links.
- [Working at IKEA](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/jobs/working-at-ikea/): Overview of IKEA as a workplace, including culture and values.
- [Areas of work](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/jobs/areas-of-work/): Introduction to different functions and career paths across IKEA.
- [Students and graduates](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/jobs/students-and-graduates/): Early-career opportunities, internships, and graduate-focused information.
- [Meet our coworkers](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/jobs/meet-our-coworkers/): Employee stories describing roles, experiences, and growth at IKEA.
- [Search jobs](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/jobs/search-jobs/): Job search entry point for current IKEA openings.

## Newsroom
- [Newsroom](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/newsroom/): Central newsroom for press releases, updates, and media resources.
- [Press releases](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/newsroom/press-releases/): Official announcements on launches, partnerships, and company developments.
- [Statements](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/newsroom/statements/): Corporate statements and responses on important issues and events.
- [Media kit](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/newsroom/media-kit/): Brand and media resources for journalists and press use.
- [Contacts](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/newsroom/contacts/): Media contact information for press and communications inquiries.

## Our Business
- [Our business](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/our-business/): Main overview of IKEA’s business model, value chain, and direction.
- [About IKEA](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/our-business/about-ikea/): Introduction to IKEA’s purpose, concept, and global presence.
- [How we work](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/our-business/how-we-work/): Explanation of how IKEA operates across development, sourcing, and retail.
- [Business areas](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/our-business/business-areas/): Overview of major parts of the IKEA business and their roles.
- [Value chain](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/our-business/value-chain/): Summary of the end-to-end IKEA value chain from idea to customer.
- [Growth and strategy](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/our-business/growth-and-strategy/): Information on long-term priorities, development, and business direction.

## Sustainability and Responsibility
- [Sustainability](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/our-business/sustainability/): Overview of IKEA sustainability priorities and commitments.
- [Climate](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/our-business/sustainability/climate/): Information on emissions reduction, energy, and climate-related action.
- [Circularity](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/our-business/sustainability/circularity/): Focus on reuse, repair, materials, and circular product design.
- [People and communities](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/our-business/sustainability/people-and-communities/): Work related to social impact, livelihoods, and community support.
- [Responsible sourcing](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/our-business/sustainability/responsible-sourcing/): Standards and practices for materials, suppliers, and sourcing.
- [Healthy and sustainable living](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/our-business/sustainability/healthy-and-sustainable-living/): Efforts to help customers live more sustainably at home.

## Brand, Design, and Innovation
- [Democratic Design](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/our-business/democratic-design/): IKEA design philosophy balancing form, function, quality, sustainability, and low price.
- [Product development](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/our-business/product-development/): How IKEA develops products for home furnishing needs at scale.
- [Innovation](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/our-business/innovation/): Work on new ideas, technologies, and future home solutions.
- [Design at IKEA](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/stories/design-and-innovation/): Story collection covering designers, products, and creative processes.
- [Collaborations](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/newsroom/press-releases/): Press coverage of partnerships, collections, and collaborative launches.

## Governance and Company Information
- [About IKEA](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/our-business/about-ikea/): Company background, purpose, and high-level overview of IKEA globally.
- [IKEA franchise system](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/our-business/ikea-franchise-system/): Explanation of the IKEA franchise model and how the brand is operated.
- [Code and policies](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/our-business/how-we-work/): Entry point for understanding operational principles and ways of working.
- [Supply chain](https://www.ikea.com/global/en/our-business/value-chain/): Overview of sourcing, production, logistics, and distribution in the IKEA system.
- [Inter IKEA Group](https://www.inter.ikea.com/): Corporate site for Inter IKEA Group, owner of the IKEA concept and worldwide franchisor.

## Regional and Shopping Entry Points
- [IKEA.com](https://www.ikea.com/): Main IKEA domain with access to country and market storefronts.
- [Find your local IKEA](https://www.ikea.com/): Country selector and entry point to local shopping experiences.
- [IKEA United States](https://www.ikea.com/us/en/): US storefront for products, rooms, services, and online shopping.
- [IKEA United Kingdom](https://www.ikea.com/gb/en/): UK storefront for home furnishing products, inspiration, and services.
- [IKEA Germany](https://www.ikea.com/de/de/): German storefront for shopping, planning, and local store services.
- [IKEA Sweden](https://www.ikea.com/se/sv/): Swedish storefront for products, inspiration, and customer services.

## Related Corporate Resources
- [Inter IKEA Group](https://www.inter.ikea.com/): Corporate information about the IKEA concept owner and franchisor organization.
- [IKEA Foundation](https://ikeafoundation.org/): Independent philanthropic foundation supporting vulnerable children and families.
- [IKEA Museum](https://ikeamuseum.com/en/): Museum site covering IKEA history, design heritage, and exhibitions.
- [IKEA Today](https://ikeatoday.com/): Corporate storytelling and workplace-focused content from the IKEA ecosystem.
